note:
Involves adding a new field to the task object, and updating the backlog artefact UI to display it.

The identifiers should use incremental numbers.
reply: Live (page version 7): every task has a number, #1 to #104 by when it was added (this one is #89), never reused. It shows before the title and in the details (click to copy #89); search #89 finds it; #89 in a description, my notes or the trail links to the task. New tasks take the next number, yours and mine alike. Also new: Redo (⇧⌘Z) and undo for adding a task. Reload any open tab of the page
text: Add unique identifiers for each task on the backlog
